items.title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
items.description: The mistrial now puts the murder case - and Clancy's future - in limbo as to whether she will be held criminally liable in the deaths of her three kids.

items.title: US envoys arrive in Moscow ahead of Ukraine talks
items.description: Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are due to hold talks with Russia before travelling to Ukraine on Sunday.

items.title: Europe targeted by spiralling campaign of sabotage - and Russia is the chief suspect
items.description: Germany has blamed Russia for an attack on Leipzig airport but there has been a series of suspicious incidents elsewhere.

items.title: Nepal rescuers try to reach dozens trapped in tunnel after two found alive
items.description: More than 1,300 people have died and thousands are missing, but rescuers' hopes have risen after finding survivors in a tunnel.

items.title: Trump signs order to remove endangered species protection for grey wolves
items.description: The US president says the move will help ranchers, but conservationists say it could derail efforts to recover populations.

items.title: UN votes to adopt new world map to reflect Africa's true size
items.description: The Togo-sponsored resolution was backed by 164 nations - with the US as the only nation to vote against it.

items.title: Germany's far-right AfD bids for first taste of power in eastern vote
items.description: If it wins an outright majority in Saxony-Anhalt, it would be the first time a far-right party has held state-level power in Germany since World War Two.
